role: The Syllabus production Postgres holds 445,868 articles (NYRB, The Nation, New Yorker, LRB, Atlantic, FT, WSJ, Economist, Bloomberg…) chunked and embedded with jina-embeddings-v3. Read-only for us; semantic recall needs the same embedding model in the querying service. Historical depth is the differentiator: how an argument has been made since the 1960s.
notes: Credentials are secret and read-only; no URL by design.
